name: Deskhush Notice Cleaner
author: jasonmad

sections.description:
For agencies and site builders who want a quieter wp-admin for administrators — not client handoff dashboards.

Free

  • Classify notices (promotional / security / update / other)
  • Hide promotional notices globally
  • Per-plugin allow and block lists
  • Drag-and-drop admin menu reorder and hide (administrator role)

Security and update notices are never hidden.

Pro

  • Notice Drawer in the admin bar for suppressed notices
  • Per-role menu layouts
  • Role presets (Editor / Client / SEO)
  • Re-apply saved menu order after plugin updates (single-site)
  • Page Insight (which plugins run on the current admin screen)
  • Export and import configuration

Pairs well with: Deskhush Client Dashboard for client-role admin chrome; Deskhush Client Editor for content-region locks.

This Free package is fully usable on its own. Pro is distributed separately via Freemius.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins screen
  3. Open Deskhush Notices in the dashboard
sections.faq:
Does this lock paid features inside the free plugin?

No. Everything shipped in this package works. Pro features live in the Pro package.

Will administrators get locked out of menus?

No. Menu hiding is configuration you control, and administrators keep Settings access to this plugin.

How is this different from Deskhush Client Dashboard?

This plugin cleans your (administrator) admin notices and menus. Deskhush Client Dashboard hides chrome for client roles. Deskhush Client Editor locks content regions on pages.

Does this support WordPress Multisite?

Not in v1. Use on single-site installs only.
